name: Ponpon Land
source:
Our protagonist Ryuuzou has loved big bellies ever since childhood.

One day, he meets Mr. Onaka, his mother's (future) husband, only to discover that every single member of the Onaka family possesses a magnificent, large belly.

However, if he were to suddenly reach out and touch one, it'd be considered sexual harassment—a social death sentence! Yet, he simply *must* touch those big bellies swaying right there before his eyes!

Thus begin Ryuuzou's days of agonizing internal conflict...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8903]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
我们的主人公龙三从小就喜欢大肚子。

有一天，他遇到了母亲（未来）的丈夫奥纳卡先生，却发现奥纳卡家族的每个成员都拥有一个巨大的大肚子。

但如果他突然伸手去触碰，就会被视为性骚扰，等于被判了社会死刑！然而，他就是“必须”摸摸眼前那摇晃的大肚子！

龙三痛苦的内部冲突的日子就这样开始了……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8903]Novelgame[/url]]
